description.zh: 祐德稲荷神社与茨城县笠间稻荷、京都伏见稻荷并称「日本三大稻荷」，位于佐贺县鹿岛市的悬崖峭壁之上，以依山而建的殿堂和绿意覆盖的山岳景色著称，外形壮观宏伟，有「九州之日光」的美誉。神社楼门、拜殿以朱红色涂漆，在绿山映衬下格外夺目。
description.en: Yūtoku Inari Shrine, alongside Kasama Inari (Ibaraki) and Fushimi Inari (Kyoto), is one of Japan's three great Inari shrines. Perched on a cliff face in Kashima, Saga Prefecture, its cliff-hugging halls set against forested mountain scenery have earned the nickname 'Kyushu's Nikkō'. The vermilion-lacquered rōmon (tower gate) and oratory are breathtaking against the green hillside.

location.en: Koeda Otsu, Kashima City, Saga Prefecture

zh: 楼门：依山建造的三层楼门高约18米，为国家重要文化财
奥之院展望台：穿越千本鸟居后到达，可俯瞰有明海与周边田园风光
秋季红叶：11月前后神社山体的枫叶与朱红建筑相映成趣，是九州著名红叶名所
en: Rōmon (tower gate): an ~18 m, three-storey gate built into the cliff face, designated an Important Cultural Property
Oku-no-in viewpoint: reached through the torii corridor, with panoramic views of Ariake Sea and surrounding farmland
Autumn foliage: late November maple colours against vermilion buildings make this a celebrated Kyushu foliage spot

tips.zh: 从博多站乘特急约1小时至肥前鹿島站，再换乘出租车或巴士约15分钟。每年11月上旬举办的秋季大祭香火极旺。从长崎方向亦可较便捷地前往。
tips.en: From Hakata, take a Limited Express ~1 hour to Hizen-Kashima station, then taxi or bus ~15 minutes. The autumn Grand Festival in early November draws large crowds.
